environment: Flutter test VM with native File.readAsBytes; not a physical device or browser
interpretation: Base parse and two-cell viewport/geometry work were under 0.7 seconds combined in this run. Each distinct selected cell loaded the complete 24-entry chlorophyll timeline, causing 24 file reads and about 2.5 seconds of work per selection. Re-selecting the first cell used the MarineMapCubit result cache and did no file reads.
limits: One local run; elapsed times depend on machine load and filesystem cache.
File read counts and bytes are repeatable for the same asset snapshot; timings are directional only.
